glossary.definition: (1) "External audit" means a quality assurance review of a testing authority that is conducted by a forensic DNA testing agency outside of, and not affiliated with, the testing authority.
glossary.scope: (B) As used in division (A) of this section:

glossary.definition: (2) "Internal audit" means an internal review of a testing authority that is conducted by the testing authority itself.
